The method integrates the scene's depth buffer into the sphere tracing loop defined in [Distance-field ray marching](21-distance-field-ray-marching.md) [S2, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly describes a technique where the scene's depth buffer is sampled and converted to a true distance value. This distance value is then passed as a parameter to the raymarching function. Inside the raymarch loop, the algorithm checks if the current traveled distance exceeds this mesh depth, breaking the loop if it does. This confirms that the method integrates the depth buffer into the sphere tracing (ray marching) loop.
